document.title: Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India (API) Monograph Framework
document.authority: Pharmacopoeia Commission for Indian Medicine & Homoeopathy (PCIM&H)

sections.content: General Notice 1.1 establishes official identity monograph parameters, macroscopic and microscopic characteristics, total ash, acid-insoluble ash, and alcohol-soluble extractive limits for single plant drugs.

sections.section_title: Heavy Metal, Pesticide Residue and Microbial Contamination Limits
sections.content: General Notice 2.4 sets mandatory permissible limits for heavy metals (Lead, Cadmium, Arsenic, Mercury), pesticide residues, and aflatoxins in raw materials used for manufacturing Ayurvedic medicines.
